welcome.text: This guide is for team leaders, who lead market day: setting up, running the session, and closing it.

yours.text: Sign in to the dashboard on your phone. Managing workers and the guest database stay with coordinators; the rest of market day is yours.

checklist.text: Start with the Checklist, under More. The banner at the top confirms today’s session is scheduled.

stations.text: Then set up both stations, the room display and check-in. Tick each step as you go, and a finished station folds away.

unlock.text: If the line board asks for an unlock code, Get an Unlock Code gives you one. Volunteers will ask you for it.

printing.text: At check-in, the printing station’s Online step ticks itself once the station is running.

today.text: Today takes it from there. Registration opens and closes on its own, and guests appear as they sign up.

adjust.text: Under Change the Plan, extend registration if guests need more time, or Close Early to end it now.

lottery.text: After a short grace period, the lottery draws by itself. Run Immediately draws it now.

queue.text: Once the lottery is drawn, volunteers call guests up from the queue desk.

addGuest.text: For someone who couldn’t register, Add Guest, then Give them a spot, puts them at the end of the line.

broadcast.text: If service runs late, Broadcast Notification reaches every guest who signed up for updates, exactly as written.

close.text: When nobody is left to call, Close Session ends the day, and next week’s market is ready.

thanks.text: Thank you for leading the market.
